The '''Feast of Worms''' was a celebration on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]] marking the autumnal equinox. At sunset, celebrants would fill the streets, some carrying paper and daub versions of the Beasts of [[Syclos]], fantastical creatures depicted in the [[Grimoire of Syclos the Lame]].
